message.content: The nodules were found when the doctors examined me – they weren’t looking for anything else on a scan. The only thing I’ve noticed is a mild darkening of the skin over my finger joints and knees; I haven’t had fever, night sweats, cough, unusual tiredness, weight loss, dizziness, low blood pressure, salt cravings, nausea or any other symptoms.
